question: The average age of 24 students of a class is 46 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 47 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of new entrant = New Average + (Old members × Increase in Average)

Teacher's Age = 47 + (24 × 1)

Teacher's Age = 47 + 24 = 71

**∴ The correct answer is 71 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 24

Average age of 24 students = 46 years

New average age after including the teacher = 47 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of People
